scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function walk(d){fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(e=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(e.name.endsWith('.wasm')&&fs.statSync(p).size>25*1024*1024){console.log('Splitting oversized wasm:',p);const b=fs.readFileSync(p);const h=Math.ceil(b.length/2);fs.writeFileSync(p+'.part0',b.subarray(0,h));fs.writeFileSync(p+'.part1',b.subarray(h));fs.unlinkSync(p);}})}walk('build');fs.writeFileSync('build/_worker.js','export default{async fetch(req,env){const u=new URL(req.url);if(u.pathname.endsWith(\".wasm\")){const p0=await env.ASSETS.fetch(new URL(u.pathname+\".part0\",req.url));const p1=await env.ASSETS.fetch(new URL(u.pathname+\".part1\",req.url));if(p0.ok&&p1.ok){const b0=await p0.arrayBuffer();const b1=await p1.arrayBuffer();const m=new Uint8Array(b0.byteLength+b1.byteLength);m.set(new Uint8Array(b0),0);m.set(new Uint8Array(b1),b0.byteLength);return new Response(m,{headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/wasm\"}});}}return env.ASSETS.fetch(req);}};');"
